NH HB224 — Ratepayers Could Get Refunds from Renewable Energy Fund

New Hampshire could return excess money from the Renewable Energy Fund to electric ratepayers. The bill would require the Department of Energy to rebate funds, after covering administrative costs and incentive payments, back to all retail electric ratepayers on a per-kilowatt-hour basis. ...
